title: US Strikes Target Two Locations in Iran's Fars Province; No Casualties Reported
text:
US Strikes Target Two Locations in Iran's Fars Province; No Casualties Reported"

"July 30, 2026, US Army Attacks Empty Sports Hall in Farashband City, Fars Province."

"Early Thursday morning, US forces carried out attacks on two locations in Iran's southern Fars Province, targeting the counties of Kazerun and Farashband, according to local authorities."

"The Fars Governor's Office confirmed that the pre-dawn strikes hit two sites in the counties. One of the targets was a sports hall in Farashband. According to provincial officials, the attacks resulted in no casualties.
